incidents.title: Currently experiencing LOGIN issues

incidents.body:
Earlier today we identified and resolved an issue impacting customers using our PHP and Ruby SDKs. A backend API change deployed on Friday 5/8/26 ~2:30PM PT inadvertently broke request parsing for certain payloads sent with the Ruby and PHP SDKs. As a result, occurrences sent during this window were rejected and not recorded.

We rolled back the change this morning (5/9 at 8:30 am PT) and occurrence ingestion is back to normal.

Unfortunately, occurrences that were dropped during the affected window, were not stored and cannot be recovered. We understand thats a gap in your observability and we take that seriously.

We’re conducting a full postmortem and will publish details on our statue page. In the meantime if you’re still seeing issues or have questions, please don’t hesitate to reply here.

incidents.title: Increased occurrence processing pipeline latency

incidents.body:
This incident was resolved. Rollbar processing pipeline latency (measured at p99) was elevated above our 30-second p99 SLO today during the following windows:

02:02AM - 02:35AM PDT: 30s - 7.0 minutes latency
06:02AM - 07:03AM PDT: 30s - 3.9 minutes latency
08:00AM - 09:02AM PDT: 30s - 37.2 minutes latency
09:02AM - 09:52AM PDT: 30s - 23.1 minutes latency

p50 stayed at SLO (~5s) during the entire time period, and no data was lost. The initial cause analysis is a particular traffic pattern. We're investigating the root cause to ensure the system is resilient to this traffic pattern going forward.

incidents.title: Service Disruption Across Infrastructure

incidents.body:
**# Incident Report

## Summary of the Incident and Impact**

From 2025-09-03 05:35 PT until approximately 14:03 PT, the Rollbar ingestion API) served a high rate of 502 errors because a particular traffic pattern exhausted the resources available to other traffic. The range of 502 errors ranged from 30% to 60% of requests during the incident. Once the root cause was identified and mitigated, error levels returned to below 0.01%.

The Web App and Processing tiers were not affected.

[1] POST requests to api.rollbar.com/api/1/item , api.rollbar.com/api/1/item_batch/ , api.rollbar.com/api/1/items/ 

**## Follow-Up Actions**

We've identified follow-up actions to mitigate going forward 1) the length of similar incidents (completed), 2) the possibility of similar incidents (planned).
